summary: Read a sequence of integers named A. Call it nondecreasing when every earlier index holds a value less than or equal to every later index. Call it nonincreasing when every earlier index holds a value greater than or equal to every later index. Judge the sequence monotonic when at least one of those two descriptions fits, and write true; otherwise write false. The length is at most 50000, and each value lies on the closed span from -100000 to 100000.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
